_comment: Known credential exposures, recorded 8 August 2026 so the gate can go green and
therefore survive, while nothing is quietly forgotten. Every entry is printed on
every run with its required action. Anything NOT listed here fails the build.
THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. Adding an entry means accepting an exposure, and that
is the owner's decision to make, not an agent's.
ROTATION NOTE, which applies to every db_password entry below: these files are
COMMITTED. Deleting the line does not undo the exposure — git keeps history, and
the repository is on GitHub as VIPTwisted/twisted-growers-enterprise-os. The only
thing that actually closes these is changing the tg_desktop_reader password.
The owner was told this on 8 Aug 2026 and elected not to rotate for now.
